description: Wang Qingxian is In charge of the overall work of the government
educationInfo: Wang Qingxian began his first job in July 1983 and joined the Communist Party of China (CPC) in August 1986. He completed a graduate program and was awarded a Doctor of Economics degree. He is a senior journalist.
careerInfo: Wang is currently Deputy Secretary of the CPC Anhui Provincial Committee, Governor of the People’s Government of Anhui Province and Secretary of its Leading Party Members Group. From September 1979 to July 1983, he studied philosophy at Department of Philosophy, Nankai University. After graduation, he served as an assistant journalist at Heilongjiang Daily. From September 1987 to July 1990, he attended a graduate program in journalism at Graduate School of Chinese Academy of Social Sciences and was awarded a Master of Laws degree. In July 1990, he became an editor and a director journalist at the Division of Economy of People’s Daily. In May 1996, he served as assistant editor-in-chief (Deputy Director General-level) at China Reform Daily. In January 2000, he became editor-in-chief at China Information News. (From September 2000 to July 2003, he attended a graduate program in national economy at Department of Government Policy and Public Administration, Graduate School of Chinese Academy of Social Sciences and earned a Doctor of Economics degree.) In September 2004, he began to serve as Deputy Sectary-General of the People’s Government of Shanxi Province and Director of its Research Office. In February 2006, he became Executive Deputy Director of Publicity Department of the CPC Shanxi Provincial Committee. In January 2008, he was elevated to Secretary of the Leading Party Members Group of the General Office of the People’s Government of Shanxi Province. In April 2008, he became Secretary-General of the People’s Government of Shanxi Province and Secretary of the Leading Party Members Group of its General Office. In January 2011, he became Deputy Secretary of the CPC Jincheng Municipal Committee of Shanxi Province and Acting Mayor of Jincheng City. In April 2011, he served as Deputy Secretary of the CPC Jincheng Municipal Committee of Shanxi Province and Mayor of Jincheng City. (From March to July in 2012, he took a training class for young and middle-aged officials at the Central Party School.) In February 2013, he served as Deputy Secretary of the CPC Yuncheng Municipal Committee of Shanxi Province and Acting Mayor of Yuncheng City. In March 2013, he became Deputy Secretary of the CPC Yuncheng Municipal Committee of Shanxi Province and Mayor of Yuncheng City. (From June 2014 to July 2015, he presided over the work of the CPC Yuncheng Municipal Committee.) In May 2016, he became Secretary of the CPC Lvliang Municipal Committee of Shanxi Province. In November 2016, he served as a member of the Standing Committee of the CPC Shanxi Provincial Committee and Director of its Publicity Department. In November 2017, he became a member of the Standing Committee the CPC Shandong Provincial Committee and Director of its Publicity Department. In December 2017, he served as a member of the Standing Committee of the CPC Shandong Provincial Committee, Director of its Publicity Department and President of Shangdong Federation of Social Science Associations. In January 2018, he served as a member of the Standing Committee of the CPC Shandong Provincial Committee, Director of its Publicity Department, Secretary of its Educational Work Committee and President of Shangdong Federation of Social Science Associations. In April 2018, he served as a member of the Standing Committee of the CPC Shandong Provincial Committee, its Secretary-General, Director of its Office of the Leading Group for Deepening Overall Reform and Secretary of its Work Committee for Provincial-level Administrative and Public Institutions. In October 2018, he served as a member of the Standing Committee of the CPC Shandong Provincial Committee, its Secretary-General, Director of its Office of the Leading Group for Deepening Overall Reform, Director of its Office of National Security Committee and  Secretary of its Work Committee for Provincial-level Administrative and Public Institutions. In January 2019, he became a member of the Standing Committee of the CPC Shandong Provincial Committee, and Secretary of the CPC Qingdao Municipal Committee and President of its Party School. In January 2021, he served as Deputy Secretary of the CPC Anhui Provincial Committee and Secretary of the Leading Party Members Group of the People’s Government of Anhui Province. In February 2021, he became Deputy Secretary of the CPC Anhui Provincial Committee, Governor of the People’s Government of Anhui Province and Secretary of its Leading Party Members Group. Wang has been a delegate to the 19th National Congress of the CPC and a deputy to the 12th and 13th National People’s Congress.
summary: Wang Qingxian is the Governor of the government body in Anhui, China.

careerInfo: He served as Deputy Director and Consultant in national government organs; Deputy Director and Director in subordinate sections of the government organs. He was a member of the Standing Committee of the CPC Municipal Committee of a prefecture-level city and Secretary of the CPC District Committee (director-general level). He then worked as Deputy Secretary of the CPC Municipal Committee of a prefecture-level city and Secretary of the Municipal Party’s Commission for Discipline Inspection (director-general level). He served as Director of the office of the leading group on inspection, the CPC Committee of an autonomous region, then he served as a member of the Standing Committee of the CPC Committee of an autonomous region and Director of its office of the leading group on inspection. Then, he became a member of the Standing Committee of the CPC Committee of an autonomous region and head of its Party’s Commission for Political and Legal Affairs. Afterwards, he worked as a member of the Standing Committee of the CPC Provincial Committee and Secretary of the Provincial Party’s Commission for Discipline Inspection. He then served as a member of the Standing Committee of the CPC Provincial Committee, Secretary of the Provincial Party’s Commission for Discipline Inspection and Director of the Provincial Supervisory Commission.
summary: Liu Hui is the Executive Vice Governor of the government body in Anhui, China.

careerInfo: Wang is currently Vice Governor of the People’s Government of Anhui Province, a member of the Standing Committee of All-China Federation of Industry and Commerce and Chairwoman of Anhui Federation of Industry and Commerce. From Sep. 1980 to Jul. 1984, she studied law at Department of Law of Anhui University. After graduation, she became a teacher with Department of Economic Management of East China College of Metallurgy. In Jul. 1994, she served as a teacher with East China College of Metallurgy and Director of the No. 4 Law Office of Ma’anshan. (In Sep. 1997, she was promoted to Associate Professor.) In Sep. 1998, she became Deputy Dean of Department of Economic Law at School of Law of East China College of Metallurgy and Director of Ma’anshan Tianyi Law Office. In May 1999, she served as Deputy Director of Ma’anshan Justice Bureau. (From Sep. 1999 to Dec. 1999, she attended the 4th training course for Directors of Justice Bureau at Central Leadership Institute of Politics and Law). In Aug. 2000, she was promoted to Deputy Director-general of Department of Justice of Anhui. (From Sep. 2001 to Jul. 2004, she took a graduate program on law at Law School of Anhui University and was awarded a Master degree of law.) In Feb. 2012, she became Director-general of Department of Justice of Anhui. In Jan. 2013, she served as Deputy Director of the Standing Committee of the People’s Congress of Anhui Province. In Aug. 2017, she became Deputy Director of the Standing Committee of the People’s Congress of Anhui Province, and Chairwoman of Anhui Federation of Industry and Commerce. In Nov. 2017, she served as Deputy Director of the Standing Committee of the People’s Congress of Anhui Province, a member of the Standing Committee of All-China Federation of Industry and Commerce and Chairwoman of Anhui Federation of Industry and Commerce. In Jan. 2018, she became Vice Governor of the People’s Government of Anhui Province, a member of the Standing Committee of All-China Federation of Industry and Commerce and Chairwoman of Anhui Federation of Industry and Commerce. Deputy to the 11th, 12th and 13th National People’s Congress
